name: URL Deduplicator
description: Remove duplicate URLs across all entities in a single pass. Supports URL normalization (default) or fuzzy title+company matching for cross-source dedup. First occurrence wins — duplicates are flagged with a reference to the original.
usage_notes: Run first in Step 2. Removes duplicates before expensive operations. Use 'url' match strategy (default) for same-source dedup. Use 'title_company' for cross-source dedup where the same job appears on multiple boards with different URLs.

options.name: match_strategy
options.label: Match strategy
options.description: How to detect duplicates. 'url': normalize and compare URLs (fast, same-source). 'title_company': fuzzy title match + exact company match (cross-source dedup).

options.name: fuzzy_threshold
options.label: Fuzzy match threshold
options.description: Dice coefficient threshold for title similarity (0.0-1.0). Only used with title_company strategy. Higher = stricter matching.

options.name: normalize_www
options.label: Treat www and non-www as same
options.description: Consider www.example.com and example.com as duplicates.

options.name: normalize_trailing_slash
options.label: Ignore trailing slashes
options.description: Consider /page and /page/ as the same URL.
